item.text:
Final turn complete. The report at [report.md](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-09_14-01-25-hashicorp_raft-baseline/work/report.md) is finalized and internally consistent (status reads "nine independent methods"; 848 lines; 29 evidence files).

This concludes the audit. There is no further investigation available within the authorized scope: every source file has been read, the provenance question is blocked by the lack of network, the socket-dependent transport tests cannot run, and nine independent verification methods have been exercised.

Deliverable summary:

- **Finding 1 — one confirmed defect (low severity).** `cluster.EnsureSamePeers` (`testing.go:691`) snapshots its reference peer set once, outside its `WAIT`→`CHECK` retry loop. Since the preceding `EnsureSame` only compares FSM command logs, and configuration entries never enter those logs, a node can lag when `peerSet` is captured, leaving it permanently stale so the helper fails after 5 s on a fully consistent cluster. Confirmed in three shipped tests; mechanism-verified by goroutine dump and a propagation-lag measurement (15% stale-at-first-read); causally validated by a one-line refresh in a scratch copy that made the re-tested cases pass 20/20, with a fresh checkpoint (6/20, 6/20, 0/20) saved for re-verification.

- **No consensus-level defect.** Complete source review of the root module plus nine independent methods — the shipped suite, a 40-test core-consensus batch, three custom invariant harnesses (~16k acked commands), the repository's full `fuzzy` suite, and race-detector runs — all clean: zero divergence, zero acked-command loss, zero races in the audited code.

- **One open item, stated honestly rather than asserted:** whether that helper is the injected mutation or a latent upstream flake. It is undecidable in this environment because the module cache's sumdb records fail signature verification (so the cache cannot certify a pristine tree) and no other upstream reference is reachable.

- **Two scoped secondary observations:** the in-repo `fuzzy` module lacks a `RequestPreVote` case (needs `PreVoteDisabled` against raft ≥1.7) and its transport has an unlocked data race — tooling/submodule issues, explicitly not raft correctness defects.

Everything needed to reproduce or extend the work is preserved under `work/`: the report, `audit-evidence/` (29 logs and dumps), six `//go:build auditdiag` diagnostics, `repro/` tools, `_scratch_fixcheck/`, and `_scratch_fuzzy/`. The captured implementation was never modified, and the default build and `go vet` are clean.
